experiments.evidence: Own same-page A/B through uGeStone at zoom 28.5, 1080p, on real both-sides fights with VFX, overlays and fog on, at seeds and moments the engineer did not use: rift High and Ultra seed 83 t645, bridge High seed 59 t414 (local player dead, grey grade) and seed 71 t526 (colour), fray High seed 37 t278. Folder _harness/_shots/gfx_verify_GE: report_*.json, report_part2.json, *_fight_a/b.png, *_tele_a/b.png, sbs_*.png, scripts ge_verify.mjs, ge2.mjs, an.py, an2.py. A against a second A differs by 0 (max 1 on fray), so the deltas are the switch. Looked at full frames and actual-size crops: the before ground is airbrushed; the after ground reads as worked stone with grit and pits. Plain on BRIDGE and FRAY, whose flat slabs fill the frame (sbs_fray_fight.png, sbs_bridge_fight.png). Smaller on RIFT, where the flags are already painted and a fight covers more of them, and there it is easier to see side by side than in play. Pixels changing by more than 2: 5.96 % rift, 8.86-11.43 % bridge, 12.10 % fray, against 0.2-0.4 % for the GR-1 that was reverted. The engineer's 'clearly less airbrushed' holds by eye; his high-pass figures, and my 3-12 px band on stone (+2 to +3 %), understate it. Worse: nothing I could see. Fighters and bars stand off the ground the same; no repeat, band or fade edge visible at zoom 24.5 or 36. Hue: stone r/g and b/g move at most 0.0004, frame mean RGB +0.14 to +0.38 of 255, so no team-colour shift. Telegraphs: delta over ground high-pass 2.00 to 1.99 rift, 2.74 to 2.71 bridge, 2.90 to 2.88 fray, same footprint (fighter frames, not his bench spots). Shimmer: sub-pixel creep second-difference pops above 3 levels are flat, 2.834 to 2.849 %, 1.085 to 1.092 %, 2.853 to 2.860 %, so the layer is not aliasing. In a 5 m/s pan, frame-to-frame residual after integer alignment rises 1.65 to 1.75 rift, 0.71 to 0.91 bridge, 1.14 to 1.26 fray, and pops 38.5 to 40.2 %, 18.4 to 21.4 %, 27.0 to 28.1 %. That is what more fine detail in motion gives, and with creep flat I read it as content, not flicker; stills and numbers cannot fully settle how it feels in motion. Measurable, not visible: the added layer autocorrelates 0.14 at 104-105 px on RIFT, the grit tile's 1.23 m period (terrain_glsl.ts: p * 26 / 32, not rotated). 13-68 pixels a frame change by more than 20, mostly on thin lines and ring edges with a few isolated ones (3-9 new bright a frame); I did not trace the cause. No sparkle field. Tiers: uGeStone reads 0 on Low and 1 on High and Ultra, including across live switches low, high, ultra, low, high (every report's tiers row), and High and Ultra change the same pixels. Budgets: triangles, draws, programs, textures and geometries identical A/B in every frame (rift 267700/179/39, bridge 326922/205/38, fray 83580/81/30, rift Low 196313/149/27, bridge Low 312963/176/27). Ground samplers 14 of 16 on RIFT, 13 on BRIDGE and FRAY; the tile takes one, so RIFT has 2 left. Own value_probe, seed 83, t 200, --flash 0 on three maps High and Low: 82 PASS, 0 FAIL, lane p50 90/90, 90/90, 87/87 (_harness/_reports/gfx_verify_ge_value.json). His perf report reads 451989 triangles, 253 draws, 40 programs, peak memmaps 1967 MB (gfx_ge_perf.json); I ran no sweep. Memory A/B not read by anyone: his 350 KB is an estimate, and it checks against 256 x 256 RGBA with mips. The tile is still allocated on Low; only the layer is skipped, so Low carries that memory and one branch. GPU, every-frame paired A/B over 150 pairs: median difference +0.51 ms rift, +0.63 bridge, +1.06 fray, interquartile range about -17 to +19 ms, load 7-8. ABBA blocks at load 12-30 are noisier still. All positive but unresolved, so this is not_measured evidence, and no 60 fps result exists for it on any tier. Sensitivity: ground grain only, no new forms or faces.

regressions: Not blocking: with GE-1 on, the 5 m/s pan residual rises 6-27 % and pops rise 1.1-3.1 points; sub-pixel creep is flat. Read as added detail, not aliasing. Best confirmed by eye in live play.
summary: Pass, with the frame-time half left to the idle gates. GE-1 stays on all three maps: on my own fight frames the stone is plainly less airbrushed, clearest on BRIDGE and FRAY and smaller on RIFT, with no telegraph, fighter, hue, tier or budget harm I could find, and 82 PASS, 0 FAIL on my own value_probe. Its GPU cost is unresolved: +0.5 to +1.1 ms median at load 7-8 with a spread far wider than that, so no timing here counts as a pass, and 60 fps with it on is still unproven. I ran no perf_1080 and took triangle, memory-peak and match-program figures from his report; A/B counts come from my frames. GE-2 and GE-3 are correctly rejected, judged from his sheets and the code, not re-run; their sheets have misaligned rows. Other things found: the memmaps row match_4_rift reads 41 programs, over the 40 bar. It also reads 41 in fw_CW1_r3x_perf4, r3x_perf5 and r3y_perf1, so GE did not cause it, but someone should own it. His 'honed disc stays clean' refers to the plaza disc; FRAY's central disc does carry the layer, and it looks fine. BRIDGE's Snap stub does read as a puckered shape at the game camera (bridge_high_s59_fight_b.png), as he hands off. The verdict is at _design/reviews/fixwaves/GFX_GE_verify1.json per the task's last instruction, not _design/reviews/gfx/GE_verify1.json from its ownership line.
